deck_description:
Another "I didn't actually top" decklist, but I'm very happy with how the list performed so I wanted to do another writeup.

I was scared of Angelechy going into the regional, but then ran into two of them and just...walked straight through their endboard only mildly singed by Destrier, and ended up never needing to think about Shatranga. I wanted three Typhoons but only had one, so I chucked in two Cosmic Cyclone, actually saw the Cyclone, and then never had to use it.

Boss on Parade bridging into Crystron via Gray Layer is actually way better than I expected, because it means 11 out of ~17-18 + 3 Mammoth starters end in followup for next turn. And that kept coming up every single round. I only mained 2 Funk Dock because even though it's the best starter going 1st, it's awful to see in your opening hand going 2nd.

Mammoth paired with Metal Slave is a surprisingly good boardbreaker that goes 2-for-1 at minimum, but I only ever saw Mammoth going 1st and only I resolved the Helping Robo search once. I don't agree with trying to Clockwork Night for it, Helping Robo gets locked out if you resolve Cannon and summon a non-machine from your opponent's hand.

----

Matchups: Rolad Branded (lost die / LL), VSK9 (won die / WW), Angelechy (lost die / WW), Angelechy (won die / WW), Rolad 60card (won die / LWL), Yummy Azamina FTK (won die / WLW).

Both losses make the Rolad matchup look bad, but R1 G1 I opened double nib into < 5 summons and got drolled, G2 no starters in a deck that should have ~95% consistency. R5 was G1 Fuwa + handtraps + Goemon (I skipped Cannon because Fuwa), G3 I opened no non-engine and scooped to avoid a double loss.

A direct copy of DarkArmedDuelist's Barrel Dragon deck.

Video Link: https://youtu.be/VEdduusxw1k?si=hsotEHoNtma5AQ7B

deck_name: The Duel Has Begun! - Sadie (Tag Force Evolution)
deck_description: The Duel Has Begun! - Sadie (Tag Force Evolution)

I think I finally figured out a way to play rescue ace pretty consistently in genesys. I have seen enough disappointing lists where nobody has made a deck that does more than just the turbulence line. I tried this list with more infernoble cards but it was way more inconsistent and didn't achieve much. Unfortunately I did not find a way to get this to 40 cards, it's probably possible by cutting down on R-Ace names, but I did not want to minimise that since they're the star of the show. If you feel it's absolutely necessary a 43 card list with 2 air lifter, 2 hydrant, 1 quick attacker would likely be fine but I have not tested it. The deck ends up being a lot of gas and I don't see many hand traps in test hands, so some cards in hand do end up redundant. Usually this is saved by these cards being hand trap bait or extenders. 

Air lifter is a good starter, but you can go for more out of ash or junk meister as one card starters.
When going for the ash line, it is better to summon jet synchron from the OSS than hydrant. Jet + flamberge gets powertool (for durendal) and also searches junk meister. This allows you to go into AFD to special summon air lifter from hand (searched with durendal) and bridges into R-Ace plays. 

For the junk meister line, you can either go through Angelica (jet synchron) or power tool dragon (revolution synchron) to get durendal without using your normal summon. Power tool dragon is generally better since you can follow it up with crystal wing to insulate your plays. But if you have drawn one of the equip spells Angelica is better. Use her to find the equip name you don't have, and then use durendal to search air lifter. When equipping durendal, DO NOT CHAIN ANGELICA. Use her effect to tag out when equipping almace. This gets you to Roland, and with some extra steps, you can end with Roland in grave, both power tool braver dragon and Charles on field (with at least one s/t zone free), and the usual hydrant + turbulence on field (contain, extinguish, and rescue set) + preventer in grave. 

I have not tried many lines into high impact hand traps (i.e. droll, nib, charmies) but you can generally just go for a board with a lower ceiling. If you get to Crystal wing early, you can be nib-proof.   

All in all, it's fun. I need to pick up a lot of these cards to play this in person, so this will have to live online for the time being.

deck_description: Both bridge together cleanly for ALOT of interruptions

Hey! This deck was made as a tribute to Jeff Leonard, who won with Exodia in a clever way. Here, you will see the similar pattern but instead of Pendulums, Level 3 monsters will do it. If you don't know how to use them, check this deck!

 

 

Gameplan

1) Before getting rid of Gabonga, don't forget to replace it with Fortress to get a Spell for Monk usage, which is "Unveiling Mail".

2) Use Monk to place Ferret and replace Ferret with Conjurer + Chlamy + Lilith. Then, replace Saryuja with Zealantis to reset the board. After the reset, activate Conjurer to get a Spell named "Magical Dimension" and use Lilith to set Chain Material.

3) Reuse Monk to place Mark and find Temple. Also, Link Summon Selene to place Monk again. Depending on your opening hand, here is what you should bring via Monk...

  • If you have head of Exodia, place Blue Dragon Summoner.
  • If you don't have head of Exodia, place Witch of the Black Forest.

4) After the activation of Temple + Chain, use Chlamy to place Ambulo by using 2 x Chlamy as materials. When Ambulo is here, you can search another Spell called "Predapruning" and tribute Blue/Witch via Ambulo to place Cobra. Besides Cobra searching "Fusion Gate" to unlock your Fusion setup, based on what you have put in #3, here is what you can search...

  • Blue Dragon Summoner >>> Limbs of Exodia
  • Witch of the Black Forest >>> Head of Exodia

5) To search all Exodia pieces, Selene has to be reused at most four more times to win the duel on the spot! In order to do so, here is the play pattern via Gate...

  • Electrum#1
  • Chorozo = Electrum#1 + Mark
  • Augo = Aleister + Chorozo >>> Banish Ambulo in GY whenever possible
  • Elysium = Augo + Selene >>> Banish Electrum#1
  • Electrum#2 >>> Recover Electrum#1 + Chorozo + Augo + (Ambulo) + Elysium + Selene + Mark + Aleister

6) When you have played Electrum#2, that means you can replay Selene to place Monk and Monk can place Blue. From hereon, whenever you Link Summon Selene, you can only place Blue because you have used last Spell for Monk usage, which was "Predapruning". Since the repeated pattern in #5 leaves Blue onboard anyhow, Link Summoning Selene with Blue as material in mind can find you limbs of Exodia regardless.

7) Repeat what was explained in #5 and #6 until you win the duel with Exodia!

 

If you wonder how to save up some SR and UR points, I can show you:

- "Xyz Armor Fortress" can be found by purchasing "Rage of Deep Blue" Structure Deck to save 30 SR!

- "Dugg Charger" + "Wind-Up Magician" + "Wind-Up Shark" + "Grand Entrance" + "Zenmaity" + "Zenmaintenance" + "Big Gabonga" can be found within "Bonkers Bikers' Wild Wheels" Secret Pack to save 240 SR and 120 UR!

- "Exodia the Forbidden One" can be found within either "Fires of Infinity" or "The Great Olds" Secret Packs to save 30 SR!

- "Lilith, Lady of Lament" can be either found within "Illusion Beast's Roar" or "Rulers of Darkness" Secret Packs to save 30 UR!

- "Predaplant Ambulomelides" can be found within "Ravenous Invasive Flora" Secret Pack to save 30 SR!

- "Speedroid Terrortop" can be found within "Warp-Speed Toys" Secret Pack to save 90 SR!

- "Aleister the Invoker" + "Invoked Elysium" can be found within "Master of Forbidden Spells" Secret Pack to save 30 SR and 30 UR!

- "Summoner Monk" can be found within "True Awakening of the Oathbound Knights" Secret Pack to save 30 SR!

- "The Man with the Mark" + "Temple of the Kings" can be found within "Infernal Labyrinth of No Escape" Secret Pack to save 30 SR and 30 UR!

- "Worldsea Dragon Zealantis" can be found within "Raging God of the Sea" Secret Pack to save 30 UR!

- "Primathmech Alembertian" can be found within "Supreme Strike" Secret Pack to save 30 UR!

So, in total, you can save up to 750 SR and 330 UR, if you are willing to spend some gems. Other SR and UR cards I didn't mention are essential.
